title: Fascicular
summary: FASCIC'ULAR, adjective [Latin fascicularis.] United in a bundle; as a fascicular root, a root of the tuberous kind, with the knobs collected in bundles, as in Paeonia.

inlines.v: FASCIC'ULAR, adjective [Latin fascicularis.] United in a bundle; as a fascicular root, a root of the tuberous kind, with the knobs collected in bundles, as in Paeonia.
